Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for the operation of roll your own cigarette machines at retail establishments.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to persons who operate a roll your own cigarettemachine at retail establishments; and adding a new section to chapter70.158 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.158 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: For the purposes of this chapter and chapters 70.157 and 82.24 RCW,every person who operates or maintains a machine at a retailestablishment that enables the person to process a product made orderived from tobacco into a roll or tube shall be deemed to be amanufacturer of cigarettes. The resulting product shall be deemed tobe a cigarette.
